name: main_run_coverage
caption: Main-comparison configurations against training seeds, one cell per configured run, with completion supported by the saved summary, partial-trace percentages relative to the configured update budget and explicit absence of local records.

name: component_run_coverage
caption: Five conditional component removals against three training seeds at a fixed 50% credit mixture, one cell per configured run, labelled completed, partial trace, or no local output.

name: training_loss
caption: Training loss against update for each main run, smoothed over five logged batches, with mixture medians from completed runs; dotted traces are incomplete local runs.

name: training_cost
caption: Recorded training time, synthetic tasks per second and final loss against updates per downloaded main run, grouped by prior mixture.

name: gradient_health
caption: Recorded total and block gradient norms against training update for downloaded main runs, with clipping reference and mixture colours.

name: development_curves
caption: Development monitoring score against update for each downloaded main run, with mixture means at common supported updates and incomplete local traces shown separately.

name: development_control_gap
caption: Development monitoring-score differences between credit mixtures and their 0% controls, paired by training seed and exact recorded update. Lines show the mean paired difference and bands show ±1 sample standard deviation across paired seeds; all pairs must contribute at each plotted update. Zero marks equal monitoring performance. These descriptive development curves are not final cross-validation estimates.

name: development_seed_spread
caption: Final recorded development monitoring scores per completed configuration and training seed, with within-configuration ranges and means; these values are separate from final full-table cross-validation.

name: monitoring_dataset_coverage
caption: Monitoring inventory with one cell per dataset and run, identifying common development cells used in means, other scored cells, entirely missing scores and unmonitored cells.
